ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (30) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

Established English forms are used for Abu Hanifa, the caliph al-Mansur, d'Herbelot («Дербело», Derbelo), and Zschokke («Чокке», Chokke); «учение Кадда» (uchenie Kadda, 'the teaching of Kadda') and «Хаджи Абдул Гезди» (Khadzhi Abdul Gezdi) are given as printed. Matthew 10:27–28 is translated from Tolstoy's Russian, with lowercase 'him' as in the source, and Epictetus's «осуждай» (osuzhday) is 'condemn', as elsewhere in the book.
Source observation: [19] The attribution «*Конфуций*» (Konfutsiy, 'Confucius') lacks the final period that the other attributions have; probably a transcription slip. English mirrors it.
